162 use-specific roles preserve rock, weathered rock, soil, noncollision moss/shrubs, wet wood and guide wheels separately. Placements, terrain tiles, individual stones and auxiliary fixtures do not add catalogue masters.
All 312 reference candidates remain pending human art acceptance. Natural geological composition and the authored material style remain candidates, not a claim of image-perfect matching.
